comment: Per-repo deploy targets, read by .github/workflows/deploy.yml. The workflow is parity-identical across repos; everything repo-specific lives here. contentMarker is a string the deploy agent must find in the served page — proof the right site answered, not just any 200. NOTE: production publicUrl is the onrender.com hostname until the wearestudio810.com cutover — the apex domain still serves Squarespace. Update publicUrl (and nothing else) when the cutover lands.
